neighborhoods: Elmsford (Westchester); pulls FROM NYC ACC + South US + Cayman; adopts NYC metro

notes: 501(c)(3) since 2015 (NYS Reg #RR184), ACC New Hope partner. WALK-IN no-kill shelter at 100 Warehouse Lane South, Elmsford 10523 (~25 min north of the Bronx), Mon-Fri 11-3, Sat 10-4. Explicitly RESCUES FROM NYC ACC plus the US South and Cayman Islands - so NYC dogs are literally here. First-come-first-adopt for pre-approved questionnaires; private meet-and-greet rooms. A close option to meet dogs in person; a short drive north of the Bronx. Email: (via site contact form) Intake: walk-in shelter, questionnaire first
